class LRUCache:
    """Least-Recently-Used cache with O(1) get and put."""

    class _Node:
        __slots__ = ("key", "value", "prev", "next")

        def __init__(self, key, value):
            self.key = key
            self.value = value
            self.prev = None
            self.next = None

    def __init__(self, capacity: int):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self._map: dict[int, LRUCache._Node] = {}
        # Sentinel head/tail to avoid None checks
        self._head = self._Node(0, 0)  # most-recently-used end
        self._tail = self._Node(0, 0)  # least-recently-used end
        self._head.next = self._tail
        self._tail.prev = self._head

    # -- internal helpers --------------------------------------------------

    def _detach(self, node: _Node) -> None:
        node.prev.next = node.next
        node.next.prev = node.prev

    def _attach_head(self, node: _Node) -> None:
        """Insert *node* right after head (most-recently-used position)."""
        node.next = self._head.next
        node.prev = self._head
        self._head.next.prev = node
        self._head.next = node

    # -- public API --------------------------------------------------------

    def get(self, key: int) -> int:
        if key not in self._map:
            return -1
        node = self._map[key]
        self._detach(node)
        self._attach_head(node)
        return node.value

    def put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None:
        if key in self._map:
            node = self._map[key]
            node.value = value
            self._detach(node)
            self._attach_head(node)
        else:
            if len(self._map) == self.capacity:
                # Evict LRU (node just before tail)
                lru = self._tail.prev
                self._detach(lru)
                del self._map[lru.key]
            node = self._Node(key, value)
            self._map[key] = node
            self._attach_head(node)

import pytest
from lru import LRUCache


class TestEvictionOrder:
    """Tests that the cache evicts the least-recently-used item first."""

    def test_evict_lru_on_full_cache(self):
        cache = LRUCache(2)
        cache.put(1, 1)
        cache.put(2, 2)
        cache.put(3, 3)  # evicts key 1
        assert cache.get(1) == -1
        assert cache.get(2) == 2
        assert cache.get(3) == 3

    def test_eviction_respects_access_order(self):
        cache = LRUCache(2)
        cache.put(1, 1)
        cache.put(2, 2)
        cache.get(1)       # makes 1 most-recently-used
        cache.put(3, 3)    # evicts key 2 (was LRU)
        assert cache.get(1) == 1
        assert cache.get(2) == -1
        assert cache.get(3) == 3

    def test_fifo_eviction_without_access(self):
        cache = LRUCache(3)
        cache.put(1, 1)
        cache.put(2, 2)
        cache.put(3, 3)
        cache.put(4, 4)    # evicts key 1
        assert cache.get(1) == -1
        assert cache.get(2) == 2
        assert cache.get(3) == 3
        assert cache.get(4) == 4


class TestUpdateAsUse:
    """Tests that updating an existing key promotes it to most-recently-used."""

    def test_put_updates_value_and_mru(self):
        cache = LRUCache(2)
        cache.put(1, 1)
        cache.put(2, 2)
        cache.put(1, 10)   # update key 1, makes it MRU
        cache.put(3, 3)    # evicts key 2 (was LRU)
        assert cache.get(1) == 10
        assert cache.get(2) == -1
        assert cache.get(3) == 3

    def test_get_also_promotes(self):
        cache = LRUCache(2)
        cache.put(1, 1)
        cache.put(2, 2)
        cache.get(1)       # promotes 1 to MRU
        cache.put(3, 3)    # evicts key 2
        assert cache.get(1) == 1
        assert cache.get(2) == -1
        assert cache.get(3) == 3


class TestCapacityBoundary:
    """Tests edge cases around capacity limits."""

    def test_capacity_one(self):
        cache = LRUCache(1)
        cache.put(1, 1)
        assert cache.get(1) == 1
        cache.put(2, 2)    # evicts key 1
        assert cache.get(1) == -1
        assert cache.get(2) == 2

    def test_put_into_empty_cache(self):
        cache = LRUCache(1)
        assert cache.get(1) == -1
        cache.put(1, 42)
        assert cache.get(1) == 42

    def test_get_nonexistent_key(self):
        cache = LRUCache(2)
        assert cache.get(999) == -1

    def test_put_same_key_twice_no_eviction(self):
        cache = LRUCache(2)
        cache.put(1, 1)
        cache.put(1, 10)   # update, not insert
        cache.put(2, 2)    # should NOT evict key 1
        assert cache.get(1) == 10
        assert cache.get(2) == 2

    def test_exact_capacity_fill(self):
        cache = LRUCache(3)
        for i in range(1, 4):
            cache.put(i, i)
        for i in range(1, 4):
            assert cache.get(i) == i
        cache.put(4, 4)    # evicts key 1
        assert cache.get(1) == -1
        assert cache.get(4) == 4
